## Question

<!-- One sentence. Phrase it so that evidence could prove it wrong. -->

## Decision this informs

<!-- What changes if the answer is yes, no, or inconclusive? -->

## Evidence and design

<!-- Link public data, describe a synthetic design, or say what private data you can summarize. Name the unit of analysis, baseline, and comparison. -->

## Scope

<!-- What is in scope, what is explicitly out of scope, and what would make this too large? -->

## Deliverable

<!-- Report, chart, table, reproducible analysis, or a combination. Where should it live? -->

## Constraints

<!-- Time, budget, compute, access, consent, and publication limits. -->

## Stop condition

<!-- What result or blocker ends the investigation instead of triggering another iteration? -->

## Privacy and publication check

- [ ] The request contains no secrets, credentials, personal data, or private repository details.
- [ ] Any private data will be summarized as an aggregate or with direct identifiers removed.
- [ ] The proposed output can be published in this repository.
